published_implementation.historical_relation: Public evidence payload migrated from the predecessor function-specific record; organizational interpretation remains derived.

audit_loop: executor produces a candidate repository change and completion contract
a separate adversarial reviewer inspects the diff and repository against the task
reviewer emits REQUEST_CHANGES plus concrete discrepancy findings
the runner returns those findings to the original executor session
the executor performs one revision round
the benchmark independently reruns build, visible tests and held-out verification on the revised state
observations.comparison_scope_note: FULL also contains a deterministic done-gate and schema-forced result contract. The two L2 records establish operation and closure of the complementary review-revision-reverification loop; they are not an isolated causal estimate of reviewer contribution to overall task success.
observations.publisher_boundary_note: The README describes the benchmark reviewer/harness as a minimal clean-room implementation of production patterns rather than production Telos code. No native Telos or Claude Code S3* ownership is inferred.
